name: Spell Effect: Sparkleskin
text:
Granted by Sparkleskin

You gain a +2 status bonus on Deception checks to Create a Diversion and to Feint, and on Performance checks to Perform that have the visual trait.

When you take damage, creatures in a 5-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is dazzled for 3 rounds.
